datasets.name: ODSCustomers
datasets.sql: select c.rowid,c.id,c.name||' '||c.surname||' '||c.fathername as name,c.address,c.mobilephone,c.fax from ins_customers c where id=:id

datasets.name: ODSCondition
datasets.sql: select idr.rowid, idr.* from ins_dict_conditions idr where id=:vid

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid, ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where id= :cid
and type_id = 5

datasets.name: ODSAgent
datasets.sql: select id,(name||' '||surname||' '||fathername) as name from ins_agents

datasets.name: ODSCPropertySuggest
datasets.sql:
select icp.rowid, icp.* from ins_cproperty_suggest icp
where bid = :bid

datasets.name: ODSCProperty
datasets.sql: select  icp.rowid,icp.* from ins_commercialproperty icp where cid=:cid

datasets.name: ODSReport
datasets.sql:
SELECT ic.surname || ' ' || ic.NAME || ' ' || ic.fathername AS NAME,
       ic.surname || ' ' || ic.NAME || ' ' || ic.fathername AS NAME2,
       ic.address,im.inssumm ,'(mob.):'||ic.mobilephone||'; (ev):'||ic.homephone as phone,  
       to_char(ict.begin_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') begindate, 
	to_char(ict.begin_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') begindate2, 
       to_char(ict.ins_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') insdate,
       to_char(ict.end_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') enddate, 
       ict.policy_num policynum,ict.beneficiary,       
       im.ammount,im.franshiz,im.cost,
       val.val_name valute,im.locationobj,im.insured_obj, 
       ia.surname||' '||ia.name||' '||ia.fathername as agent, 
       ict.loanacc_id, ict.curracc_id
  FROM ins_contracts ict,
       ins_commercialproperty im,             
       ins_customers ic,
       avalute val,
       ins_agents ia
 WHERE 
ic.ID = ict.kli_id 
and ict.id = im.cid
and ict.valute_id = val.valute(+)
and ict.agent_id = ia.id(+)
and ict.id = :CID
